meta.title: View Contract — composition of patterns OR custom render

definition.description: A View is a composition unit. It maps PatternInstances to layout slots, OR provides a custom JSX render function. Views are the lazy boundary (NOT patterns) to avoid request waterfalls.

invariants.invariant: Views are lazy by default. Patterns inside a view share its chunk.
defineLayoutView and defineRenderView are SEPARATE functions (no mode flag).
A View MUST declare every PatternInstance with a unique slot key.
A View NEVER reads from a provider directly; patterns do.
Custom render Views receive a typed `patterns` resolver, not raw children.

gates.gate: Layout views have at least the `main` slot.
Render views declare all referenced patterns in `patterns` array.
View has a *.view.test.tsx with provider mocks.
View bundle ≤ 160kb gzip (sum of its patterns).
